items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: I felt that when I came in the band, how, you know, after I got in there and found what was going on, and the different personalities, and it was still -- you know -- it was still Basie's band, in other words.

ctx.x: They -- bands like that like to keep it that way. And, Basie came along and he did the -- he had his thing going.
